selection: Eligible only if validation MAE strictly decreases and validation within20 strictly increases versus delivered ensemble. Among eligible, minimize 0.5*(MAE/baselineMAE + missFraction/baselineMissFraction). Baseline retained if none.
source_shortlists: Best two validation-dual-score candidates separately from ANN pool, CatBoost training-CV finalists, alternative training-CV finalists. Preserve all source results.
pairs: Each of six shortlisted candidates plus delivered ensemble
Each of two shortlisted ANN candidates plus delivered random forest
aggregation: Convex arithmetic mean in original KZT. Weight belongs to first named component.
ANN_extension: May add two corrected+literal-steering five-seed pool candidates using the same predeclared MAE/dual checkpoints; extractor derived from TRAIN only. No other ANN architectures or seed subsets will be searched.
test_access: None during candidate search. Freeze one final selection first; one retrospective evaluation then stops this round. Do not iterate further after test.
independence: Historical reused split; no independent generalization claim. No target-dependent gating or actual-price input. No trim/delete evaluation rows.
